pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Volume Autocorrelation Shock Mean Reversion (Liquidity Persistence/Clustering Burst Fade)
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Compute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of real quote volume over 48h, z-score over 168h (causal) -> ac1_z. Fade extreme volume-persistence/clustering bursts: ac1_z >= 1.25 and ret_W>0 -> SHORT; ac1_z >= 1.25 and ret_W<0 -> LONG. Extreme anti-persistence (ac1_z <= -1.25) -> no entry (pre-stated asymmetry). Exit on ac1_z < 0.25, max hold 12h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 trades high vol_z LEVEL (first-moment) momentum continuation; C51 uses z-score of rolling lag-1 AUTOCORRELATION of qvol (serial dependence/persistence) as a shock fade.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH volume climax on aggregate vol_z level; C51 fades VOLUME PERSISTENCE/CLUSTERING (autocorrelation) — a temporal-dependence statistic, not volume level.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 continues on LOW vol_z dry-up breakout; C51 mean-reverts on extreme volume autocorrelation/persistence shocks.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms breakouts on volume expansion (level); C51 uses volume autocorrelation (serial structure) shock fade, no breakout/expansion confirmation.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades volume-price divergence using unsloped vol_z at price extremes; C51 uses ac1_z (volume persistence) shock with ret_W confirmation — different transform and trigger.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c44: C44 trend-follows on vol_z ROC acceleration; C51 mean-reverts on extreme ac1_z persistence shocks, no ROC/acceleration.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c45: C45 mean-reverts on Amihud illiquidity shocks (|ret|/volume, price-impact ratio); C51 uses rolling autocorrelation of qvol (temporal dependence), not a price-impact ratio.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c46: C46 continues on OBV (cumulative sign*vol) slope divergence vs price slope; C51 uses ac1_z volume-persistence shock fade — different transform (serial dependence vs OBV slopes) and opposite mechanic.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c47: C47 uses up/down volume split imbalance ratio (directional partitioned sums) exhaustion fade; C51 uses rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of total qvol (temporal clustering) — different construction.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c48: C48 uses z-score of rolling STD of qvol (2nd-moment dispersion/volatility-of-liquidity); C51 uses z-score of rolling AUTOCORRELATION of qvol (serial dependence) — distinct temporal-structure statistic, not a marginal dispersion moment.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c49: C49 uses z-score of rolling EXCESS KURTOSIS of qvol (4th-moment tail-fatness); C51 uses z-score of rolling AUTOCORRELATION of qvol (serial dependence/persistence) — different statistic measuring temporal clustering vs tail shape.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c50: C50 uses z-score of rolling SKEWNESS of qvol (3rd-moment distributional asymmetry); C51 uses z-score of rolling AUTOCORRELATION of qvol (serial dependence/persistence) — different statistic measuring temporal clustering vs distributional asymmetry.

summary.edge_rule: exposure>0 AND all cost-grid slices OOS net>0 AND OOS net>B&H on same OOS windows (pre-stated, fail-closed)
